battle.name: 朱粲起義
battle.brief: 大業十一年（615年），汝州冠軍人朱粲聚眾起事；大業十二年遣使附李密，受授揚州總管、鄧公；義寧元年為李孝恭擊破巴蜀；武德元年復勸李密進位，五月遭馬元規擊於冠軍，七月又為周超所敗。攻城靠砲車、撞車、雲梯，官軍憑城堞與弩砲拒守；卡面羅馬扭力弩砲比本役早六百六十餘年，與東亞床弩同類。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 大業末年的河南，是隋朝最先失血的地方。這場戰爭的交戰一方是朱粲在汝州冠軍聚起的武裝，聚眾數萬，多為河南山東的失業農民、逃戶、散兵與鄉里豪強，馬步混編，器械自備，首領只有朱粲一人，沒有隋朝那套完整的軍府與符節體系；另一方是隋廷在河南的留守官府，以洛陽為樞紐，靠郡兵、縣兵與城防民兵固守州縣治所，再派出撫慰使、刺史一級的官軍掃討鄉里。大業十一年之後，主持河南的洛陽朝廷已換成越王侗的皇泰主政府，太府卿元文都、納言段達一班人分掌朝政與兵柄，山南一線則歸撫慰使馬元規與宣州刺史周超分節制。瓦崗軍的李密站在中間：大業十二年朱粲遣使歸附，被授揚州總管、鄧公，兩家因此是同盟；李唐是外來者，義寧元年李淵派從父兄子李孝恭出山南招撫，在金川擊破朱粲一部，隨後以檄文招得巴蜀三十餘州。河北的竇建德、山東的孟海公、兗州的徐圓朗與朱粲同列，618年正月一同遣使奉表勸李密進位，說明河南這批武裝已連成一氣；而東都的王世充在同年十月發動政變，殺死元文都、盧楚，盡握洛陽兵權，把朱粲、李密、王世充三方擠進同一座城下的死局。
countriesEn: Henan in the last years of Daye was the first place from which the Sui began to bleed. On one side of this war stood the armed band Zhu Can gathered at Guanjun in the commandery of Ru: tens of thousands of men, for the most part out-of-work farmers, runaways, stray soldiers and local magnates from Henan and Shandong, horse and foot mixed together and supplying their own arms, with no commander but Zhu Can himself and none of the elaborate army-administration and tally system of the Sui. On the other side stood the Sui administration left behind in Henan, pivoted on Luoyang: commandery soldiers, county soldiers and city militia holding the seats of the prefectures and counties, and then officers of the pacification and inspectorate grade sent out into the countryside to hunt the insurgents. After the eleventh year of Daye the authority in Henan had passed to the government of Huangtai, the Prince of Yue who had taken the throne at Luoyang, with such men as the Master of the Treasury Yuan Wendu and the Vice-Censor-in-Chief Duan Da sharing out the government and the command of troops, while the line of the Southern Mountains was divided between the pacifier Ma Yuanguo and the Inspector of Xuanzhou Zhou Chao. In between stood Li Mi of the Wagang: in the twelfth year of Daye Zhu Can sent envoys to attach himself to him and was made Grand Commander of Yangzhou and Duke of Deng, so that the two were allies. The Tang was an outsider: in the first year of Yining, 617, Li Yuan sent his cousin Li Xiaogong out through the Southern Mountains to spread pacification, and Li Xiaogong broke one of Zhu Can's columns at Jinchuan, after which his proclamation drew in more than thirty prefectures of Shu and Ba. Dou Jiande of Hebei, Meng Haigong of Shandong and Xu Yuanlang of Yanzhou stood in the same line as Zhu Can; in the first month of 618 the four of them together sent envoys with a memorial urging Li Mi to take the throne, which shows that the armed groups of Henan had drawn into one camp. Meanwhile at the eastern capital Wang Shichong carried out a coup in the tenth month of the same year, killed Yuan Wendu and Lu Chu, seized all military authority in Luoyang, and pressed Zhu Can, Li Mi and himself into a single deadly knot beneath the same city.
people: 朱粲是這場戰爭的主角，汝州冠軍人，隋末河南起義中少數能連續數年在史冊上留下記錄的首領。他的生平細節傳世記載有限，諸說並存：通鑑只記他大業十一年起事、大業十二年遣使附李密而得授揚州總管與鄧公、義寧元年為李孝恭所破、武德元年五月敗於馬元規於冠軍、七月再敗於宣州刺史周超，此後他的下落便不見於記載。瓦崗那邊的李密既是他的舊主也是他的對手：大業十二年接受朱粲歸附，618年正月在竇建德、朱粲、孟海公、徐圓朗四家勸進之下仍答以「東都未平，不可議此」，把稱帝的時機壓在洛陽之後；攻洛陽一役中李密擁兵三十餘萬陳於北邙，段達、韋津出兵拒之而潰，李密進據金墉城，同年十月王世充夜襲含嘉門、殺元文都與盧楚，李密聞訊退回金墉。李唐這邊的關鍵人物是李孝恭，李淵的從父兄子，義寧元年以山南撫慰使之銜出金川，擊破朱粲部眾之後，諸將請盡殺俘虜，他不肯，說「自是以往，誰復肯降矣」，盡釋之，於是巴蜀三十餘州相率歸順。隋朝這邊直接與朱粲交手的兩個名字是山南撫慰使馬元規與宣州刺史周超；元文都、盧楚與王世充則是洛陽留守政府的代表，主持著那座城的存亡。
peopleEn: Zhu Can is the central figure of this war, a man of Guanjun in the commandery of Ru, and one of the very few leaders of the Henan risings of the late Sui whose name keeps appearing in the histories year after year. The transmitted record of his life is thin, and accounts differ: the Zizhi Tongjian records only that he rose in arms in the eleventh year of Daye, that in the twelfth year he sent envoys to attach himself to Li Mi and was made Grand Commander of Yangzhou and Duke of Deng, that in the first year of Yining he was broken by Li Xiaogong, that in the fifth month of the first year of Wude he was defeated by Ma Yuanguo at Guanjun, and in the seventh month again by the Inspector of Xuanzhou Zhou Chao; after that his whereabouts are no longer entered in the record. On the Wagang side, Li Mi was both his patron and his rival: in the twelfth year of Daye Li Mi accepted Zhu Can's submission, and in the first month of 618, when Dou Jiande, Zhu Can, Meng Haigong and Xu Yuanlang together urged him to take the throne, he still answered that the eastern capital was not yet pacified and the moment could not be discussed, holding back his own acclamation until after Luoyang. In the assault on Luoyang Li Mi drew more than three hundred thousand men north of the city and faced the sortie of Duan Da and Wei Jin, which broke and scattered; Li Mi took up position at Jinyong. In the tenth month of the same year Wang Shichong attacked the Hanjia gate by night and killed Yuan Wendu and Lu Chu, and Li Mi, hearing of it, withdrew again to Jinyong. The key figure on the Tang side was Li Xiaogong, Li Yuan's cousin, who in the first year of Yining went out from Jinchuan as pacifier of the Southern Mountains; after breaking Zhu Can's men he refused the request of his generals to kill the prisoners, saying that if they did so, who would ever surrender again, and released them all, after which more than thirty prefectures of Shu and Ba came over. On the Sui side the two men who actually fought Zhu Can are the pacifier Ma Yuanguo and the Inspector of Xuanzhou Zhou Chao; Yuan Wendu, Lu Chu and Wang Shichong were the representatives of the Luoyang government and bore responsibility for whether that city would hold.
kits: 卡面上這件羅馬弩砲，即今日以 scorpio 相稱的扭力式巨型弩機，是前一個世紀末葉羅軍在義大利半島造出來的攻城與野戰直射重武器：靠成束扭緊的筋索儲能，一發只出一具重箭，箭身粗重帶翼，落地猶能傷人，平射可及數百步；攻城時用來壓制城頭射孔、封住城門通道，野戰中用來封鎖道路、支援步兵登城與破壞柵欄。羅馬人正是用這類機器在迦太基戰爭與希臘諸城攻防中拆掉城牆，改變了希臘城邦的格局。本役與它隔了六百六十餘年，汝州與洛陽城下不可能有羅馬弩砲；真正與它同類同職的，是東亞自漢末以來沿用的床弩，也就是弩砲：以木為床，弩機安在床上，張弦絞發，一發一矢，矢長數尺，攻城時架在城外或車上，專射城頭守卒與女牆後的目標，與拋石用的砲車、撞門的撞車、登城的雲梯、掘進的穴地兵同時使用。守城的隋軍與唐軍則以女牆、塹溝、拒馬與火箭對抗，攻方還要靠徵發的車馬把糧秣、矢石與繩索運到城下。史載朱粲與官軍交戰時的器械數目、攻城所費的矢石以及雙方的損耗，都沒有留下可核的數字，這一點只能存疑而不宜臆測。
kitsEn: The engine on the card is the Roman heavy bolt-thrower now called a scorpio, a torsion-powered siege and field piece built in the Italian peninsula in the closing decades of the century before our era: its energy is stored in bundles of twisted sinew, it shoots a single heavy bolt at a time, the shaft thick and winged enough to keep killing after it has struck the ground, and in flat fire it reaches several hundred paces. In a siege it is used to dominate the firing slits of the battlements and seal the approaches to the gate; in the field it closes roads, supports infantry going up the wall and breaks up fences. It was with machines of this kind that the Romans pulled down the walls of Greek cities and so broke the framework of the Greek city-states. This campaign stands more than six hundred and sixty years away from that, and there could be no Roman scorpio under the walls of Ru or Luoyang; the machines that truly correspond to it in class and in task are the bed crossbows of East Asia, in use since the end of the Han, the crossbows mounted on beds: a wooden bed carrying the lock, drawn by winding, one bolt to a shot, the shaft several chi long, set up outside the walls or on a cart during a siege so as to shoot at the defenders on the rampart and at targets behind the parapet, and used together with the stone-throwers that lobbed missiles, the battering beams that worked at the gate, the scaling ladders and the miners who drove a tunnel under the wall. The Sui and Tang defenders answered with parapets, ditches, chevaux-de-frise and fire, while the besiegers had to bring up grain, ammunition and rope by requisitioned carts and animals. The transmitted records leave no verifiable figures for the number of engines Zhu Can brought against the government troops, for the ammunition spent in the assaults or for the losses on either side, and on that point one can only remain in doubt rather than guess.
tactics: 朱粲的起義不是靠正規軍的樣子打起來的。他們從汝州冠軍的鄉里聚兵，先以流動劫掠取得糧食、鐵器與布帛，避開洛陽與大郡的官軍主力，專打驛站、縣治與糧倉，靠奪取官倉的儲糧維持隊伍，越打越壯。攻城時的作法是多器並用：砲車在後排遠程拋射覆蓋城頭，撞車抵近城門猛撞，雲梯在兩翼同時靠牆，穴地隊伍在牆根掘進，弩砲架在城外與車上，專射城頭射孔，逼守軍分兵應付四個方向；打開缺口便驅趕守卒出局，就地取官倉的糧與甲兵。歸附李密之後，他得到瓦崗軍成熟的攻城技術與黎陽倉一線的糧食來源，不必再靠劫掠維持，這也是朱粲的隊伍在大業十二年至武德元年間越聚越大的原因。官軍這邊的應對分兩手：洛陽留守以郡兵固守城池，不在野外與數萬眾糾纏，同時派出馬元規、周超一級的將領帶精兵進剿，朱粲失利之後部眾散入鄉里山澤，暫時消失在有司的視野之外。李孝恭在山南的做法更進一步：他一面出兵擊破朱粲，一面以檄文宣告赦免歸順，諸將請盡殺俘虜而不從，於是金川、渝州、巴西一線的州縣接連歸順，這場戰爭最後以招撫與壓製並行的方式收束。
tacticsEn: Zhu Can's rising was not fought the way a regular army fights. The men mustered in the villages around Guanjun in the commandery of Ru, and began by taking grain, iron and cloth in moving plunder; they kept away from the main body of the Sui army at Luoyang and in the great commanderies, and struck instead at the courier stations, at the seats of counties and at the granaries, living off the grain they took from the official stores and growing stronger as they went. At a wall they worked several instruments at once: stone-throwers in the rear lobbing missiles over the battlements, battering beams set against the gate, ladders brought up on both flanks, miners digging in at the foot of the wall, and bed crossbows set up outside the walls and on carts, picking off the firing slits, so that the defenders had to divide to meet four threats at once. When an opening was forced they drove the garrison out and took on the spot the grain and the arms of the official granary. After attaching himself to Li Mi he had the mature siegecraft of the Wagang army and the grain of the line that ran from the Liyang granary, and no longer had to live by plunder; that is why his columns swelled in the years from the twelfth of Daye to the first of Wude. The government's answer worked in two ways: the Luoyang garrison held the cities with commandery soldiers and did not trade blows with tens of thousands in the open field, while officers of the grade of Ma Yuanguo and Zhou Chao took picked columns out to hunt the insurgents; after his defeats Zhu Can's men dissolved into the villages and the hills and for a while vanished from the authorities' view. Li Xiaogong in the Southern Mountains went a step further: he broke Zhu Can in the field while at the same time declaring by proclamation that those who came in would be pardoned, and when his generals asked to kill the prisoners he refused, so that the prefectures along Jinchuan, Yuzhou and Baxi came over one after another, and the war was finally closed off by a mixture of pacification and pressure.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，卻能勾出這場戰爭的輪廓。起義的時間起自大業十一年（615年），《資治通鑑》沒有留下朱粲部眾的具體人數，只記他遣使附李密與兩度被官軍擊破；同年瓦崗軍破黎陽倉，旬日之間聚得勝兵二十餘萬，說明洛陽一帶的兵源與糧食在兩三年之內已經完全換了主人。618年正月李密在金墉城擁兵三十餘萬，陳於北邙，南逼上春門，是這段時間裡規模最大的一次集結；同年東都饑荒到米斛直錢八九萬、私錢大半雜以錫環，可見攻城與圍城的真正瓶頸是糧食而不是兵員。戰役的日期有兩條明確記錄：武德元年五月，山南撫慰使馬元規擊朱粲於冠軍破之；同年七月乙巳，宣州刺史周超擊朱粲敗之。義寧元年李孝恭在金川擊破朱粲部眾之後，檄文所至，巴蜀降附三十餘州。地理上，汝州冠軍至洛陽約二百五十里，冠軍與洛陽之間的驛道與糧道是雙方反覆爭奪的地方。朱粲部眾的番號、攻城器械的數量與各場戰鬥的損失數目，傳世記載都沒有留下可核的記錄，只能從郡縣的存廢與各路將領的下落去推斷其規模。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but they are enough to give this war its outline. The rising began in the eleventh year of Daye, that is to say 615. The Zizhi Tongjian preserves no headcount for Zhu Can's followers, recording only his envoys joining Li Mi and the two defeats he suffered at government hands; in the same period the Wagang army broke open the Liyang granary and gathered more than two hundred and twenty thousand fighting men within a matter of ten days, which shows that the men and the grain of the Luoyang region had changed owners completely in two or three years. In the first month of 618 Li Mi held more than three hundred thousand men at Jinyong and deployed them north of Beiyang, pressing towards the Shangchun gate: the largest single concentration of the time. In that same year the eastern capital was so hungry that a bushel of rice fetched eighty or ninety thousand cash and more than half the private coin in circulation was mixed with tin rings, so that the real bottleneck of the siege was grain and not men. Two dates for actual engagements are clearly recorded: in the fifth month of the first year of Wude the pacifier of the Southern Mountains Ma Yuanguo struck at Zhu Can at Guanjun and broke him; and on the yisi day of the seventh month of the same year the Inspector of Xuanzhou Zhou Chao struck at Zhu Can and defeated him. In the first year of Yining, after Li Xiaogong had broken Zhu Can's men at Jinchuan, more than thirty prefectures of Shu and Ba came over in answer to his proclamation. In geography, the distance from Guanjun in Ru to Luoyang is about two hundred and fifty li, and the post road and the grain road between Guanjun and Luoyang were the ground both sides fought over again and again. The designations of Zhu Can's units, the number of siege engines and the losses of the several engagements leave no verifiable figures in the transmitted records; the scale of the war can only be inferred from the standing of the prefectures and the fortunes of the commanders on each side.
cause: 起義的根由，是大業年間河南山東的水旱與饑荒，同時加上被遠方戰事抽空的兵丁與被加重催斂的賦役。通鑑記大業末年河南、山東大水，煬帝詔開黎陽倉賑濟，吏不時給，死者日數萬人；饑民一路流向洛陽、汝州一帶的鄉里與山澤，正好落進隋廷郡縣控制最薄弱的空白處。另一層是兵力的空缺：大業十一年八月突厥深入，隋煬帝與百官宮人被圍雁門四十餘日，天下募兵之後，北方各郡的守兵被抽調一空，汝州、襄城一帶只剩守門的少量人手，朱粲起兵時不必面對成建制的官軍主力。他的兵源因此主要是河南鄉里的失業農民、逃戶與散兵，而官府的倉儲、冶坊與武庫反倒成了他最好的徵集對象。直接引爆的還有洛陽的兩個勢力爭奪：瓦崗軍在大業十二年奪得黎陽倉、散糧濟民，把河南的饑民與散兵大量吸走，朱粲若要與李密爭地，便只能先遣使歸附以換取糧食與名分；這條依附關係，也決定了朱粲此後數年的舉動必須看李密的臉色。
causeEn: The root of the rising lay in the floods and famine of Henan and Shandong in the years of Daye, together with the soldiers drawn away to distant wars and the levies and taxes piled heavier than before. The Tongjian records that in the last years of Daye Henan and Shandong were flooded, that the Emperor Yang opened the Liyang granary to relieve them, that the officials did not distribute it in time and that tens of thousands died each day; the starving drifted towards the villages and hills around Luoyang and Ru, exactly into the gaps where the Sui prefectures and counties controlled least. A second cause was the hollowing out of the garrisons: in the eighth month of the eleventh year of Daye the Turks drove deep over the frontier, Emperor Yang with his officials and his palace women was shut up at Yanmen for more than forty days, and after the call for troops throughout the empire the watch of the northern commanderies was stripped away, leaving only a handful of men to hold the gates of Ru and Xiangcheng, so that Zhu Can did not have to face a formed Sui army when he rose. His fighting men were therefore for the most part the out-of-work farmers, the runaways and the stray soldiers of the Henan countryside, while the granaries, the foundries and the armoury of the government were the best objects of all for him to take. The immediate spark lay in the contest between two powers over Luoyang: the Wagang army seized the Liyang granary in the twelfth year of Daye and gave the grain away to the people, drawing vast numbers of the starving and the scattered soldiers of Henan to itself, and if Zhu Can was to contest the ground with Li Mi he had first to send envoys and attach himself, buying grain and a name in exchange; that dependent tie also meant that for the next several years Zhu Can's moves had to follow whatever Li Mi did.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響有兩條，一條在中原，一條在西南。618年正月，竇建德、朱粲、孟海公、徐圓朗四家同時遣使奉表勸李密進位，這是隋末中原義軍第一次以聯盟的形式向一個首領靠攏；李密以「東都未平，不可議此」推開，說明洛陽仍是這一聯盟的實際爭點，而朱粲正是聯盟中與東都距離最近、位置最吃緊的一支。另一條是巴蜀：義寧元年李孝恭在山南擊破朱粲一部之後，用的是招撫為主、兵威為輔的做法，檄文所至三十餘州歸順，直接打開了唐軍南下蜀中的通道，此後巴蜀的歸附幾乎沒有再遇到大阻力。就兵器與技術而言，隋末密集的攻城作戰也讓中國自己的砲車、床弩、撞車、雲梯在實戰中被大量消耗與改裝，隋唐工官所造的攻城機械、以及唐太宗貞觀年間東征高句麗時所用的拋石車與床弩，技術底子正是在這幾年裡被亂世重新拼起來的；而卡面那件羅馬弩砲，在這整個過程中不曾、也不可能出現在河南或巴蜀的城牆下。
impactEn: The consequences of this war run along two lines, one in the central plains and one in the south-west. In the first month of 618 Dou Jiande, Zhu Can, Meng Haigong and Xu Yuanlang sent envoys with a memorial together, urging Li Mi to take the throne: it was the first time the rebel groups of the central plains drew towards a single leader in the form of an alliance. Li Mi put them off with the words that the eastern capital was not yet pacified and the matter could not be discussed, which shows that Luoyang remained the real point at issue between them, and that Zhu Can was the member of the alliance nearest to that city and in the tightest position. The other line runs to Shu and Ba: in the first year of Yining, after Li Xiaogong had broken part of Zhu Can's force in the Southern Mountains, he worked mainly by pacification with the terror of arms behind it, and more than thirty prefectures came over in answer to his proclamation, opening the road by which the Tang armies would go south into Shu, where afterwards the submission of the region met with little serious resistance. As for arms and technique, the dense sieges of the late Sui consumed and rebuilt in the field the Chinese stone-throwers, bed crossbows, battering beams and scaling ladders; the technical base of the siege machines built by the Sui and Tang workshops, and of the stone-throwers and bed crossbows used by Emperor Taizong against Goguryeo in the Zhenguan years, was assembled once again out of the experience of these few years of chaos. The Roman scorpio on the card, meanwhile, never appeared, and could not have appeared, on the walls of Henan or of Shu and Ba during any of it.
result: 結局是分散的：起義自615年發動，到618年已經被三路官軍接連打斷——五月馬元規擊朱粲於冠軍破之，七月宣州刺史周超再擊朱粲敗之，而義寧元年李孝恭在金川擊破的則是他另一支部眾。部眾散入巴蜀的州縣與鄉里，一部分被唐軍招降收編，一部分各自散為小股；《資治通鑑》記載到武德元年為止，此後朱粲本人的去向在傳世史籍中不再出現，諸說並存。對隋廷而言，汝州、襄城與山南一線的郡縣得以重收，說明一場缺乏根據地、缺乏糧食、只靠劫掠維持的武裝集團，能被以郡兵守城、將領掃討為骨架的官軍體系消化；對瓦崗的李密而言，朱粲帶來的是一個官職與一批響應，但也讓東都門外多了一個隨時可能倒向王世充的變數；對唐而言，巴蜀的通道由此打開，這才是這場戰爭留下的最實在的東西。而就兵器而言，這場戰爭沒有留下任何羅馬弩砲的痕跡，它留下的是東亞床弩與砲車體系在隋末實戰中的使用紀錄——同一個答案，在兩個世界裡各自長成。
resultEn: The ending was a dispersal. The rising began in 615, and by 618 it had been broken in three successive blows by government armies: in the fifth month Ma Yuanguo struck at Zhu Can at Guanjun and broke him, in the seventh month the Inspector of Xuanzhou Zhou Chao struck at Zhu Can and defeated him again, and in the first year of Yining the force broken at Jinchuan by Li Xiaogong was yet another of his columns. The men dissolved into the prefectures and the villages of Shu and Ba, in part taken over and reorganised by the Tang after their surrender, in part scattered into small bands of their own. The Zizhi Tongjian carries the record down to the first year of Wude, and after that Zhu Can himself no longer appears in the transmitted histories, where accounts differ. For the Sui court the prefectures of Ru, Xiangcheng and the line of the Southern Mountains could be recovered, which shows that an armed group with no base of its own and no food of its own, living only on plunder, could be digested by a government system whose backbone was the commandery soldier holding the city and the officer hunting the countryside. For Li Mi of the Wagang, Zhu Can brought a title and a body of answering supporters, but he also left an uncertain element outside the eastern capital, one that might at any moment turn towards Wang Shichong. For the Tang, the road into Shu and Ba was open, and that is the solidest thing this war left behind. As for arms, this war left no trace of the Roman scorpio; what it left was a record of the use of the East Asian bed crossbow and stone-thrower system in the sieges of the late Sui: the same answer, growing up in two different worlds.
